quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: its ultra-low-loss ocean communication fiber series includes ultra-low-loss G.654.D marine fiber for deep and far-sea transmission, ultra-low-loss multi-core fiber and bend-resistant low-loss BL fiber. In March 2026 its G.654.D fiber attenuation was cut to 0.144dB/km (company: a new record for comparable Chinese products, internationally leading), which it says gives a better base medium for future 800G, 1.6T and higher-rate coherent transmission, ocean networks and thousand-km land trunks; its high-reliability G.654.D marine fiber passed international marine expert certification and set an unrepeatered transmission record. The ultra-low-loss multi-core fiber comes in two-core and four-core structures, and the four-core product has passed authoritative sea-trial certification; in 2025 the company developed a 165μm thin-diameter ultra-bend-insensitive fiber series.
